instruction: Adversarial review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020D1 (SCP self-dogfood wrapper) at correctness lens. Slice adds .github/workflows/policy-check-wrapper.yml — the caller wrapper that invokes SCP's reusable policy-check workflow on every PR to main. Pin is @9820489fa83f64d04f641d20e99d3933cefbb04a (the 020K merge commit, latest main pre-this-PR). VERIFY: (1) YAML is syntactically valid GitHub Actions workflow grammar — `name`, `on`, `permissions`, `jobs` keys at root; `pull_request` trigger correctly nested; `branches: [main]` correctly typed as array. (2) Permissions block declares exactly `contents: read` and `statuses: write` — no extra privileges, no `id-token`, no `pull-requests: write`, no `checks: write` (matches D-029 + WP-SCP-020 020B(iii)). (3) Job-level `if:` expression correctly compares `head.repo.full_name` to `base.repo.full_name` — refuses fork PRs by comparing the full owner/repo name. The expression is evaluable at job-eval time. (4) `uses:` is pinned by 40-char commit SHA (`9820489fa83f64d04f641d20e99d3933cefbb04a`), not branch or tag name. The path format `jrnb2024/standards-control-plane/.github/workflows/policy-check.yml@<SHA>` is correct GitHub reusable-workflow cross-repo syntax (note the trailing dash in the repo name `standards-control-plane-` — verify this matches the actual repo name). (5) Renovate marker comment is correct: `# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=jrnb2024/standards-control-plane` matches the canonical adopter shape from 020H pt 3. (6) No `secrets:` block declared on the job (per 020B(iv) — caller's GITHUB_TOKEN is the ceiling). (7) No `${{ inputs.* }}` or `${{ github.event.* }}` references inside any `run:` block (the wrapper has no `run:` blocks; satisfied vacuously). (8) The wrapper does NOT pass any `with:` inputs to the reusable workflow — verify this is intentional (the reusable workflow's inputs all default to sensible values per WP-SCP-020 020B(i): rule-set='starter', threshold='deny', annotate=true, scp_bypass=false, waivers-path='output/findings/waivers.json', rule-config-path='.scp/rule-config.yaml', fixture-path='.'). For SCP self, defaults are correct. (9) The Renovate marker `tag: pre-v1.0.0-rc.1 (020K merge SHA)` is a comment — verify it doesn't accidentally interfere with Renovate's parsing. (10) Comment block at the top of the file accurately describes the slice (020D1 advisory mode), the pin lifecycle (020H.1 cuts tag, 020D1.1 ratchets pin), and references the canonical specs. Any drift from the canonical adopter wrapper shape, syntactic error, or pin format violation is a finding. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3 fixpoint criteria. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON.
